decisions.reason: The reference class electrometer is a flagship instrument in the firm's core dosimetry business, launched only a year ago with strong visibility, so it is far too early to judge its value and keeping it costs little relative to its fit with the established product line.

The oncology risk management software is a low-cost software option in an uncertain adjacent field that aligns with the firm's push toward integrated, predictive QA, and one year of results reveals too little to justify abandoning it.
